title: Our Songs
content:
Remembering the sounds of our childhood. Singing songs with our siblings. Having music lessons at school and listening to the frogs screaming at night. We run until there's nothing left. Back then, there were no borders. Just fire.

Editor – Frederik Bösing
Production Design – Martha Inés Brenner
Sound Supervision – Timo Kleinemeier
Image – Terry Kraatz & Aljoscha Wuzella
